verdict.rationale: mParticle is a CDP/data platform, not an AI agent; no evidence exists of an official MCP server for AI agents to connect to, and this axis is about a fundamentally different capability than mParticle's data-integration APIs. Given the product is not itself an agent, absence of an official MCP server would normally be 'none', but nothing in the evidence pack even gestures at AI-agent connectivity via MCP, so the story doesn't map onto this data-infrastructure product's known offerings.
